# Tanish Dave — Web Design

> Freelance web designer and developer based in Kitchener–Waterloo, Ontario, Canada. Tanish designs and builds custom, fast, mobile-friendly websites for local businesses and non-profits, with local SEO, booking and contact forms, and easy admin tools. Contact: tanishdave333@gmail.com

- Website: https://tanish-dave-websites.vercel.app/
- Email: tanishdave333@gmail.com (the best way to get in touch or request a quote)
- Based in: Kitchener–Waterloo, Ontario, Canada
- Serves: Kitchener, Waterloo, Cambridge, Guelph, Hamilton, Toronto and clients anywhere in Ontario and Canada (work is done remotely by email)
- GitHub: https://github.com/Tanish-333

## Services

- Custom website design: designed around the business's brand and customers, not a template
- Mobile-first, fast websites that work on phones, tablets and laptops
- Local SEO: page titles, descriptions, structured data, sitemaps, and fast loading so nearby customers can find the business on Google
- Online booking, ordering and contact forms
- Admin dashboards so owners can update menus, products, events and photos without code
- Redesigns of outdated or template-locked websites
- Domain and hosting setup, Google Maps, opening hours, social links and ongoing support

## How it works

1. Email Tanish about the business and what it needs (no commitment)
2. Plan the pages and features, and receive a clear quote before any work starts
3. Tanish designs and builds the site; the client reviews it before launch
4. Launch on the client's domain, with ongoing updates available

## FAQ

- Cost: depends on pages and features; email for a clear quote before any work starts
- Location: based in Kitchener–Waterloo, works with clients across Ontario and beyond
- Mobile: every site is mobile-first
- Google: every site is built with local SEO basics from day one
- Updates: clients can get admin tools to update content themselves, and Tanish is available for changes
